blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Radiologists interpret follow-up chest X-rays by comparing current and prior examinations to identify new, resolved or progressing findings. Most report generation systems either omit this longitudinal context or fuse prior features without distinguishing interval changes from anatomy that remains stable over time. We propose CPVB-RG, a prior-aware framework that combines current and prior radiographs with available clinical text. Its Cross-Prior Visual Bridge (CPVB) contains Progression-Guided Focus Attention (PGFA) and two Cross-Attention units. PGFA is designed to contrast progression-difference attention with shared-spatial attention, aiming to reduce invariant responses whilst retaining coarse spatial correspondence between examinations. The Cross-Attention units then connect the resulting longitudinal visual evidence with clinical semantics. CPVB-RG is trained in two stages, using prior-guided image-text alignment followed by autoregressive report generation with a lightweight language decoder. Experiments on MIMIC-CXR and IU X-Ray show consistent improvements across language and clinical metrics. On MIMIC-CXR, CPVB-RG achieves 0.2847 F1RadGraph and 0.6692 VLScore, with statistically significant gains over the closest decoder-matched prior-aware baseline. These results support the effectiveness of the proposed difference-aware and spatially guided fusion design for prior-aware chest X-ray report generation.
blocks.zh: 放射学家通过比较当前和以前的检查来解释后续胸X射线,以找出新的、已解决的或正在取得进展的检查结果。 大多数报告生成系统要么省略了这一纵向上下文,要么将先前的特征引信化,而不区分间隔变化和随时间推移保持稳定的解剖学。 我们提议使用CPVB-RG,这是一个将当前和以前的放射图与现有的临床文本相结合的事先认识框架。 其跨优先视觉桥(CPVB)包含进步-引导焦点注意(PGFA)和两个交叉注意单元. PGFA旨在将渐进偏差的注意力与共享空间的注意力作对比,旨在减少变化中的反应,同时保留检查之间的粗糙空间对应。 交叉观察单位然后将由此产生的纵向视觉证据与临床语义学联系起来. CPVB-RG分两个阶段进行训练,使用前导图像文本对齐,然后使用轻量级语言解码器进行自递式报告生成. 关于MIMIC-CXR和IU X-Ray的实验显示,在语言和临床指标方面都取得了一致的改进。 在MIMIC-CXR上,CPVB-RG实现0.2847 F1RadGraph和0.6692 VLScore,在统计学上比最接近的解码器比对的前意识基线有显著增益. 这些结果支持了为预知的胸X射线报告生成而拟议的差异感和空间引导的聚变设计的有效性.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Chest X-rays are among the most commonly used imaging examinations for assessing thoracic disease [ 50 , 16 ] . Automatic report generation could reduce repetitive reporting effort, but a follow-up report is not simply a textual description of the current image. Findings are often subtle and spatially localised, and their interpretation depends on whether they are new, stable or changing relative to an earlier examination [ 17 , 43 ] . Report-generation models must therefore identify interval changes while filtering responses from anatomy that remains unchanged.
blocks.zh: 胸X射线是用于评估胸膜炎的最常用的成像检查之一[50,16]. 自动生成报告可以减少重复的报告工作,但后续报告不仅仅是对当前图像的文字描述。 调查结果常常是微妙的和空间化的,其解释取决于它们是否是新的、稳定的或相对于早先的检查的变化[17、43]。 因此,报告生成模型必须识别间隔变化,同时从解剖学中过滤未变的反应。

blocks.en: Vision-language methods learn joint representations of radiographs and clinical text for report generation [ 46 , 57 , 48 ] . Most generate reports from the current examination alone and cannot directly assess temporal change. Prior-aware methods such as PriorRG [ 29 ] incorporate earlier studies, but their current and prior features are typically combined through feature fusion or attention-based interaction. Progression-related differences and spatial responses shared across examinations are not explicitly separated. This leaves stable anatomical patterns within the fused representation, where they may obscure small but clinically relevant changes [ 45 ] .
blocks.zh: 展望语言方法为报告生成学习放射图和临床文本的联合表述[46,57,48]. 大多数报告仅由目前的审查产生,无法直接评估时间变化。 前意识方法如PriorRG [29] 包含了前期的研究,但其当前和前期的特征一般通过特征聚变或基于注意力的相互作用来结合. 与进步有关的差异和在各项检查中共享的空间反应没有明确分开。 这就在引信内留下了稳定的解剖模式,在这种模式下,它们可能掩盖一些与临床相关的小变化[45]。

blocks.en: CPVB-RG addresses this limitation by combining current radiographs, prior radiographs and available clinical text. Its central component, the Cross-Prior Visual Bridge (CPVB), contains Progression-Guided Focus Attention (PGFA) followed by two Cross-Attention units. PGFA uses separate progression-difference and shared-spatial attention branches, with the aim of reducing invariant responses whilst retaining coarse spatial correspondence between examinations. The Cross-Attention units then associate the resulting longitudinal visual evidence with clinical semantics. The model is trained through prior-guided image-text alignment before generating reports autoregressively with a lightweight language decoder.
blocks.zh: CPVB-RG通过结合目前的放射图,以前的放射图和现有的临床文本来解决这一限制. 其中心构件"跨前视桥"(CPVB)包含"进步-引导焦点注意"(PGFA),之后是两个交叉注意单元. PGFA使用单独的递进偏差和共享空间注意力分支,目的是减少变化无常的反应,同时保留检查之间的粗细空间对应. 交叉观察单位然后将由此产生的纵向视觉证据与临床语义学联系起来. 该模型在使用轻量级语言解码器自动生成报告之前,通过前导图像文本对齐进行训练.

blocks.en: We evaluate CPVB-RG on MIMIC-CXR [ 16 ] , IU X-Ray [ 9 ] and 135 clinical cases. On MIMIC-CXR, it achieves 0.176 BLEU-4 and 0.515 clinical efficacy F1. Under the ReXrank MIMIC-CXR Findings protocol [ 58 ] , CPVB-RG obtains 0.2847 F1RadGraph [ 8 ] and 0.6692 VLScore [ 7 ] . These results exceed the closest decoder-matched prior-aware baseline by 0.0090 and 0.0582, respectively, with both differences being statistically significant. Component-level ablations examine CPVB, PGFA and their attention operations, while the clinical case analysis provides preliminary evidence beyond public benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 我们根据MIMIC-CXR[16]、IU X-Ray[9]和135个临床病例评估CPVB-RG。 在MIMIC-CXR上,它实现了0.176 BLEU-4和0.515临床疗效F1. 根据Rexrank MIMIC-CXR的发现协议[58],CPVB-RG获得0.2847 F1RadGraph [8]和0.6692 VLScore [7]. 这些结果分别比最接近的解码器前意识基线0.0090和0.0582超标,两者在统计学上都有显著差异. 构成部分层面的涂片检查了CPVB、PGFA及其注意力操作,而临床案例分析提供了超出公共基准的初步证据。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: (i) We introduce CPVB, whose PGFA module is designed to distinguish progression-related differences from shared spatial responses. This design aims to reduce invariant responses whilst retaining coarse correspondence between current and prior examinations (Figs. 2 and 3 ). (ii) We integrate CPVB into a two-stage report-generation framework. Prior-guided image-text alignment learns longitudinal multimodal representations that condition a lightweight 82M-parameter decoder (Sec. 3 ). (iii) We evaluate CPVB-RG on two public benchmarks and 135 clinical cases, with component-level ablations. It achieves the best NLG results among the compared methods and statistically significant gains over the closest decoder-matched prior-aware baseline on clinically grounded metrics (Secs. 4.2 and 4.4 ).
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:(一) 我们引入CPVB,其PGFA模块旨在区分与进度有关的差异和共享空间反应. 这一设计旨在减少变化无常的答复,同时保留当前和以往考试之间的粗糙对应关系(图2和图3)。 (二) 将CPVB纳入两阶段报告生成框架。 预先制导的图像文本对齐学习了纵向的多式表示法,它要求轻量级的82M参数解码器(第3节)。 (三)我们按两个公共基准和135个临床病例对CPVB-RG进行评估,并进行分层分解。 它在比较方法中取得了最佳的NLG结果,在统计学上比临床基准指标上最接近的解码器比照先前认识的基准(4.2和4.4)。

It achieves the best NLG results among the compared methods and statistically significant gains over the closest decoder-matched prior-aware baseline on clinically grounded metrics (Secs. 4.2 and 4.4 ).

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Chest X-Ray Vision-Language Learning and Report Generation
blocks.zh: 2.1 国家 胸X射线视野语言学习和报告生成

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Overview of CPVB-RG. Current and prior chest X-rays and clinical text are first encoded, after which the Cross-Prior Visual Bridge fuses their representations for prior-guided image-text alignment and autoregressive report generation. CPVB denotes the Cross-Prior Visual Bridge (Fig. 2 ), PGFA denotes Progression-Guided Focus Attention (Fig. 3 ), and CA denotes Cross-Attention.
blocks.zh: 图1:CPVB-RG概览. 胸X射线和临床文本的当前和之前的胸X射线和临床文本首先被编码,之后跨前视线桥会将它们的表达方式引信,用于前导图像文本对齐和自转报告生成. CPVB表示跨优先视觉桥(图2),PGFA表示进步-引导焦点注意(图3),CA表示交叉注意.

blocks.en: Chest radiographs often contain low-contrast findings and ambiguous visual cues, making visual representation quality important for downstream multimodal tasks [ 15 ] . Early systems commonly used convolutional networks, including DenseNet-based models such as CheXNet [ 13 , 38 ] . Vision Transformers later improved global structural modelling through token-based attention [ 11 , 44 ] , while contrastive frameworks such as CLIP aligned visual and textual representations in a shared embedding space [ 37 ] . General vision-language architectures, including ALBEF [ 21 ] and ViLT [ 18 ] , model multimodal interactions, whereas BLIP-2 [ 20 ] and LLaVA [ 28 ] connect projected visual tokens to generative language decoders. Domain-specific language models such as Med-PaLM [ 41 ] , PMC-LLaMA [ 53 ] and BioGPT [ 35 ] further support medical terminology and clinical language modelling. Recent chest X-ray systems, including CheXagent [ 6 ] , MAIRA-2 [ 2 ] and UniRG-CXR [ 31 ] , use larger multimodal decoders and broader training objectives. These systems strengthen image-text reasoning and report generation but do not explicitly separate temporal changes from anatomical responses shared across examinations.
blocks.zh: 胸形射线图往往包含低调的发现和模棱两可的视觉提示,使得视觉表现质量对下游多式联运任务很重要[15]. 早期系统常用的转录网络,包括基于DenseNet的模型如CheXNet[13,38]. 愿景变换器后来通过基于符号的注意[11,44]改进了全球结构建模,而对比性框架,如CLIP在共享嵌入空间中将视觉和文字的表示一致[37]. 一般视觉语言架构,包括ALBEF[21]和VIT[18],模式多模式互动,而BLIP-2[20]和LLaVA[28]则将预测的视觉符号与基因语言解码器连接. Med-PALM[41],PMC-LLaMA[53]和BioGPT[35]等域特有的语言模型进一步支持医学术语和临床语言建模. 最近的胸X射线系统,包括CheXagent[6],MAIRA-2[2]和UnirRG-CXR[31],使用更大的多式联运解码器和更广泛的培训目标. 这些系统加强了图像文本推理和报告生成,但并未将时间变化与所有检查共享的解剖反应明确区分开来.

blocks.en: 2.2 Prior-Aware and Longitudinal Chest X-Ray Modelling
blocks.zh: 2.2 前置和纵向胸X射线建模

blocks.en: Longitudinal report-generation methods differ in how they use information from earlier patient visits. Zhu et al. [ 59 ] combine current and prior chest X-rays with the previous report to pre-fill the Findings section. HERGen [ 47 ] integrates multi-visit records using a group causal transformer and curriculum learning, while HC-LLM [ 34 ] uses time-shared and time-specific representations with multimodal constraints to guide an LLM. MLRG [ 30 ] uses multi-view longitudinal contrastive learning, while BiOTPrompt [ 33 ] , TIM [ 10 ] and MARE [ 12 ] explore transport-based, decoupled and analogical temporal reasoning. PriorRG [ 29 ] , the closest decoder-matched prior-aware method, combines prior-guided contrastive pre-training, coarse-to-fine decoding and attention-based temporal fusion. TILA [ 19 ] learns directional changes for progression classification and retrieval, while TRACE [ 1 ] generates spatially grounded change descriptions. In contrast, CPVB-RG models current–prior interactions through separate progression-difference and shared-spatial attention branches and integrates the resulting evidence with clinical text for full-report generation.
blocks.zh: 纵向报告生成方法在如何使用早期患者诊疗信息方面有所不同.  Zhu等. [59] 将当前和先前的胸部X光与上次报告合并,以预先填充调查结果部分。 HERGen [47]使用组因果变压器和课程学习整合了多访问记录,而HC-LLM [34] 则使用时间共享和时间特定的表达,具有多种模式的限制,用于指导LLM. MLRG [30] 采用多视图纵向对比性学习,而BiOTPrompt [33],TIM [10]和MARE [12]则探索基于运输,脱钩和模拟的时间推理. PororRG [29],最接近解码器比对的前意识方法,结合了前导的对比性前训练,粗细的解码和基于注意力的时间聚变. TILA [19] 学习进化分类和检索的方向变化,而TRACE [1] 则生成空间基础的变化描述. 相比之下,CPVB-RG模型通过独立的累进偏差和共享空间注意力分支进行当前-先期互动,并将由此产生的证据与临床文本整合,以生成完整的报告。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: CPVB-RG is a two-stage framework for prior-aware chest X-ray report generation, as shown in Fig. 1 . Its inputs are a current examination, an available prior examination and clinical context such as indication or history. The visual inputs are encoded with a shared vision encoder, while the clinical context is processed by a text encoder. Their projected representations are fused by the Cross-Prior Visual Bridge (CPVB). During Stage 1, the fused representation is aligned with the corresponding Findings text, which is used only as contrastive supervision and is unavailable at inference. During Stage 2, the aligned representation conditions a lightweight language decoder for autoregressive report generation. This separation prevents the reference Findings text from entering the inference pipeline.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,CPVB-RG是前意识胸X射线报告生成的两级框架. 其投入是一次目前的检查,一种已有的事先检查和临床背景,如指示或历史. 视觉输入用共同视觉编码器编码,而临床上下文则用文本编码器处理. 他们的预测表述由跨优先视觉桥(CPVB)连接. 在第一阶段中,引信表示与相应的 " 调查结果 " 文本一致,该文本仅用作对比性监督,无法推断。 在第二阶段,对齐的表示为自动递归报告生成提供了轻量级语言解码器。 这种分离使得参考结论文本无法进入推断管道.

blocks.en: 3.1 Prior-Guided Image-Text Alignment Pre-training
blocks.zh: 3.1 前导图像文本对齐 培训前

blocks.en: The first stage learns longitudinal multimodal representations from the current examination, the constructed prior and the clinical context. The current and prior chest X-rays are encoded by a shared vision encoder, after which view-position embeddings are added to retain acquisition-specific information. The visual features are projected to a common feature dimension, and temporal embeddings distinguish the current examination from its prior. The clinical context is independently encoded and projected to the same dimension before multimodal interaction.
blocks.zh: 第一阶段从目前的检查、构建的前期和临床背景中学习纵向的多式联运表现。 目前和之前的胸X射线由共同的视觉编码器编码,之后添加了视图位置嵌入,以保留获取特定信息. 视觉特征被投射到一个共同的特征维度,时间嵌入将目前的检查与以前的检查区分开来. 临床背景是独立编码的,并投射到多式联运互动的相同层面。

blocks.en: For each current examination, a valid prior is a strictly earlier chest X-ray examination from the same patient. If multiple earlier examinations are available, we select the chronologically closest one without imposing a minimum time interval. A matching view is prioritised when available. Otherwise, the available view is retained and identified by its view-position embedding. All examinations undergo the same preprocessing, without additional subjective exclusion based on image quality. When no valid prior exists, the current visual tokens, after adding the current temporal embedding, are duplicated as the prior placeholder without introducing a prior temporal embedding or information from another patient. Although the branch-specific projections may produce nonzero differences, both branches depend solely on the current examination. PGFA therefore acts as a learned current-only refinement rather than providing evidence of longitudinal change. IU X-Ray is trained and evaluated consistently under this setting.
blocks.zh: 每一次目前的检查,有效的前科是同一病人严格较早的胸部X光检查. 如果有多次较早的考试,我们选择时间上最接近的考试,而不规定最低时间间隔。 匹配视图在可用时优先排序 。 否则,可用视图通过置入视图来保留和识别。 所有考试都经过同样的预处理,不因图像质量而额外主观排除. 当不存在有效的前置时,当前视觉符号在添加当前时间嵌入后,作为前置占位符被复制,而不引入之前的时间嵌入或来自另一个病人的信息. 虽然具体分支的预测可能会产生非零差异,但两个分支都完全依赖于目前的审查. 因此,PGFA只是现今的改进,而不是提供纵向变化的证据。 在这种背景下,对IU X-Ray进行了一致的培训和评价。

blocks.en: CPVB connects longitudinal visual evidence with clinical context. It contains a Progression-Guided Focus Attention (PGFA) module and two Cross-Attention (CA) units, as shown in Figs. 2 and 3 . PGFA first constructs separate branches to model progression-related differences and spatial responses shared by the current and prior examinations. The CA units subsequently associate these visual features with the encoded clinical context.
blocks.zh: CPVB将纵向视觉证据与临床环境联系起来. 如图2和图3所示,它包含一个进步导向焦点注意单元和两个交叉注意单元。 PGFA首先构建独立的分支,以模拟与进展有关的差异以及当前和以往检查共享的空间响应. CA单位随后将这些视觉特征与编码的临床环境联系起来.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate CPVB-RG on two public chest X-ray report-generation benchmarks, MIMIC-CXR [ 16 ] and IU X-Ray [ 9 ] . Both datasets contain paired chest radiographs and radiology reports, but differ substantially in scale. Further dataset details are provided in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 我们评价CPVB-RG两个公共胸X射线报告生成基准,MIMIC-CXR[16]和IU X-Ray[9]. 两个数据集都包含配对的胸腔放射图和放射报告,但规模差异很大. 补充材料中提供了进一步的数据集细节。

blocks.en: The common feature dimension is set to d = 768 d=768 . We initialise the vision encoder with RAD-DINO [ 36 ] and the text encoder with CXR-BERT-General [ 3 ] . DistilGPT2 [ 39 ] is used as the primary language decoder, with alternative decoders examined in the ablation study. CPVB uses 128 anchor tokens, and the maximum report length is 100 tokens. Training follows the two-stage procedure described in Sec. 3 . Stage 1 is trained for up to 50 epochs with a batch size of 32, while Stage 2 is trained for up to 50 epochs with a batch size of 16. Both stages use AdamW with a learning rate of 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} , together with learning-rate scheduling and early stopping. All experiments are implemented in PyTorch and conducted on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU.
blocks.zh: 共同特征维度设定为d=768 d=768. 将视觉编码器与RAD-DINO [36] 和文本编码器与CXR-BERT General [3] 同步。 DistilGPT2 [39] 用作主语解码器,代用解码器在lation研究中检查. CPVB使用128个锚号符,最高报告长度为100个符号. 培训遵循第3节所述的两阶段程序。 第1阶段培训最多50个世纪,批号为32;第2阶段培训最多50个世纪,批号为16。 两个阶段都使用 AdamW 的学习率为 5 × 10 − 5 5\ Times 10 × 5 + 5 → 5 + 5 + 5 + 5 + 5 + 10 + 5 + 5 + 5 + 学习率排程和早停. 所有实验均在PyTorch进行,并以单NVIDIA A100 GPU进行.

blocks.en: We use BLEU, ROUGE-L and METEOR to measure lexical agreement between generated and reference reports. Clinical efficacy (CE) Precision, Recall and F1 are computed over 14 clinical observations extracted by CheXbert [ 42 ] . Positive and uncertain labels are treated as present, while negative and unmentioned labels are treated as absent. We additionally report F1RadGraph [ 8 ] , which measures agreement between clinical entities and relations, and VLScore [ 7 ] , which assesses image–report consistency. Expert-judged report correctness is reported for the 135 clinical cases. Full metric definitions and the clinical review protocol are provided in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 我们使用BLEU、ROUGE-L和METEOR来衡量生成报告和参考报告之间的词汇协议。 临床疗效(CE)精度、召回和F1在CheXbert提取的14个临床观测中计算。 正面和不确定的标签被视为存在,而负面和未提及标签则被视为不存在。 F1RadGraph [8] 和 VLScore 的报告, 在135个临床病例中,报告的专家判断报告正确无误。 补充材料中提供了完整的计量定义和临床审查规程。

blocks.en: 4.2 Quantitative Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 量化结果

blocks.en: Tables 1 and 2 compare CPVB-RG with recent report-generation methods. On MIMIC-CXR, CPVB-RG obtains 0.428, 0.295, 0.223 and 0.176 from BLEU-1 to BLEU-4, together with 0.328 ROUGE-L and 0.196 METEOR. These are the best NLG results among the compared methods. The gains over PriorRG [ 29 ] are consistent across all six metrics, although the BLEU-4 improvement is small. On IU X-Ray, CPVB-RG reaches 0.552, 0.394, 0.281 and 0.211 from BLEU-1 to BLEU-4, with 0.423 ROUGE-L and 0.227 METEOR. Across the two datasets, CPVB-RG performs consistently with longitudinal priors on MIMIC-CXR and under the missing-prior setting on IU X-Ray.
blocks.zh: 表1和表2比较了CPVB-RG与最近的报告生成方法。 在MIMIC-CXR上,CPVB-RG从BLEU-1到BLEU-4获得0.428,0.295,0.223和0.176,连同0.328 ROUGE-L和0.196 METEOR. 这些是比较方法中NLG的最佳结果. 相对于PriorRG[29],所有6个度数的增益是一致的,尽管BLEU-4改进幅度很小. 在IU X-Ray上,CPVB-RG从BLEU-1到BLEU-4达到0.552,0.394,0.281和0.211,拥有0.423 ROUGE-L和0.227 METEOR. 在整个两个数据集中,CPVB-RG在MIMIC-CXR和IU X-Ray的缺失前置设置下与纵向前置一致。

blocks.en: Table 2: Clinical efficacy (CE) on MIMIC-CXR. P, R and F1 denote Precision, Recall and F1 score, respectively. The best results are shown in bold and the second-best results are underlined.
blocks.zh: 表2:MIMIC-CXR的临床疗效。 P,R和F1分别表示精度,回忆和F1分数. 最佳成果以粗体表示,二佳成果以粗体显示。

blocks.en: The CE results in Tab. 2 provide a complementary view of clinical observation agreement. CPVB-RG achieves the highest Precision of 0.552 and F1 of 0.515, with a Recall of 0.482. Relative to PriorRG, Precision increases by 0.011 and F1 by 0.004, while Recall decreases by 0.003. The higher F1 therefore reflects improved agreement across the extracted clinical observations rather than uniformly better performance on every CE component.
blocks.zh: CE结果在Tab. 2中提供了临床观测协议的补充观点. CPVB-RG实现最高精度0.552,F1达到0.515,复召0.482. 相对于PriorRG,精度增加了0.011,F1增加了0.04,而召回则减少了0.03. 因此,较高的F1反映了对所提取临床观测结果的一致性,而不是对每个CE部分的一致更好的性能。

blocks.en: We evaluate clinical entity–relation consistency and image–report alignment under the ReXrank [ 58 ] MIMIC-CXR Findings protocol. All methods use the same test cases, reference Findings and metric implementations, with details provided in the supplementary material. As shown in Tab. 3 , CPVB-RG obtains 0.2847 F1RadGraph and 0.6692 VLScore. It ranks second in F1RadGraph and is 0.0055 below the best VLScore achieved by the 8B UniRG-CXR. Using an 82M-parameter language decoder, CPVB-RG exceeds the 7B MAIRA-2 by 0.0200 in F1RadGraph and 0.0184 in VLScore. PriorRG is the closest decoder-matched prior-aware baseline because both methods use prior examinations and an 82M-parameter decoder. The two methods differ mainly in how they model current–prior interactions. PriorRG uses attention-based temporal fusion, whereas CPVB/PGFA models current–prior interactions through separate progression-difference and shared-spatial branches. Based on 10,000 patient-level paired bootstrap resamples and two-sided bootstrap z z -tests, CPVB-RG improves over PriorRG by 0.0090 in F1RadGraph (95% CI: [0.0048, 0.0135], p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ) and 0.0582 in VLScore (95% CI: [0.0492, 0.0673], p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ). Both improvements are statistically significant. The supplementary material also reports zero-shot transfer from MIMIC-CXR to IU X-Ray.
blocks.zh: 根据Rexrank [58] MIMIC-CXR 调查结果协议, 所有方法都使用相同的测试案例、参考结果和衡量执行情况,补充材料中提供了详细情况。 如图3所示,CPVB-RG获得0.2847 F1RadGraph和0.6692 VLScore. 它在F1RadGraph中排名第二,并低于8B UniRG-CXR所达到的最佳VLScore. 使用82M参数语言解码器,CPVB-RG在F1RadGraph中超过7B MAIRA-2的0.0200,在VLScore中超过0.0184. 先前 RG是最接近的解码器匹配的前意识基线,因为这两种方法都使用前期检查和一个82M参数的解码器. 这两种方法主要在如何模拟当前-先期相互作用方面有所不同。 先前 RG使用基于注意力的时间聚变,而CPVB/PGFA模型则通过独立的累进偏差和共享空间分支进行当前-先行相互作用. 根据10 000个病人级配对靴子的复标和双侧靴子的z-测试,CPVB-RG在F1RadGraph中比PriorRG(95% CI:[0.0048,0.0135],p < 0.0001 p < 0.0001])和VLScore中的0.0582(95% CI:[0.0492,0.0673],p < 0.0001 p < 0.0001])有所改进。 补充材料还报告从MIMIC-CXR到IU X-Ray的零射线转移。

blocks.en: 4.3.1 Effectiveness of Stage 1 Pre-training
blocks.zh: 4.3.1 阶段的有效性 1 预训

blocks.en: Fig. 4 compares the complete model with a variant trained without Stage 1. Removing prior-guided image-text alignment reduces every reported NLG and CE metric. The larger decreases in Recall and F1 indicate that Stage 1 mainly helps the generation model retain clinical observations, while the accompanying NLG reductions show that its effect is not limited to the CE evaluation.
blocks.zh: 图4 将完整的模型与未经第一阶段培训的变体进行比较。 删除先前制导的图像文本校正可减少所报告的每个NLG和CE指标。 Recall和F1的较大减少表明第1阶段主要帮助生成模型保留临床观测,而与之配套的NLG降低则表明其效果并不限于CE评价.

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Examples of generated radiology reports and their reference reports for clinical chest X-ray cases. Text in red marks clinically important content in the generated and reference reports for comparison.
blocks.zh: 图5:生成的放射报告及其临床胸X射线病例参考报告实例。 在生成和参考报告中以红色标记表示的文字具有临床重要性,以供比较。

blocks.en: 4.3.2 Ablation on Input Configuration
blocks.zh: 4.3.2 输入配置问题

blocks.en: Tab. 5 examines the effect of progressively introducing prior examinations, temporal-order information and clinical context. Using only the current examination gives 0.152 BLEU-4 and 0.311 CE F1. Adding an unordered prior does not improve performance, while encoding temporal order raises the scores to 0.158 and 0.347. Clinical context further improves them to 0.168 and 0.471. Applying CPVB to the complete input configuration achieves the best results of 0.176 BLEU-4 and 0.515 CE F1.
blocks.zh: 附录5审查了逐步采用前期检查、时间顺序信息和临床环境的影响。 仅使用目前的考试给予0.152 BLEU-4和0.311 CE F1. 添加一个未排序的前置不改进性能,同时编码时序将分数提高到0.158和0.347. 临床环境进一步改善到0.168和0.471。 将CPVB应用到完整的输入配置中,可以达到0.176 BLEU-4和0.515 CE F1.

blocks.en: 4.3.3 Fine-Grained Ablation of CPVB and PGFA
blocks.zh: 4.3.3 CPVB和PGFA的罚款

blocks.en: Having established the contribution of CPVB, we examine its internal design under controlled settings. We keep the input data, visual encoder, language decoder, training objectives and optimisation settings fixed, varying the current–prior fusion mechanism. PriorRG-Style Fusion replaces PGFA with the attention-based temporal fusion used in PriorRG, while Single Cross-Attention retains only one of the two Cross-Attention units. The remaining variants remove PGFA, its progression-difference branch or its spatial-guidance branch. Spatial Addition replaces attention-map subtraction with addition. As shown in Tab. 4 , full CPVB-RG achieves the best results across all four metrics. Removing PGFA reduces BLEU-4, CE F1, F1RadGraph and VLScore by 0.0071, 0.0411, 0.0062 and 0.0089, respectively. Removing the Difference Branch causes smaller but consistent decreases, while removing the Spatial Branch lowers F1RadGraph and VLScore by 0.0080 and 0.0048.
blocks.zh: 在确定了CPVB的贡献之后,我们审查了它在受控制环境中的内部设计。 我们保留输入数据、视觉编码器、语言解码器、培训目标和优化设置,以改变当前——优先的聚变机制。 PrealRG-Style Fusion用PrealRG中使用的基于注意力的时间聚变取代了PGFA,而单交叉加速度只保留了两个交叉加速度单元中的一个. 其余的变体去除PGFA,其递进偏差分支或其空间指导分支. 空间加法用加法取代注意力图减法。 如图4所示,完整的CPVB-RG在所有四个衡量标准中都取得了最佳结果。 取消PGFA后,BLEU-4,CE F1,F1RadGraph和VLScore分别减少0.071,0.0411,0.0062和0.0089. 删除差异处会造成较小但一致的减少,同时删除空间处将F1RadGraph和VLScore降低0.0080和0.0048。

blocks.en: Table 5: Ablation of the input configuration and CPVB. Order denotes temporal-order information, and Text denotes the available clinical context. The best results are shown in bold.
blocks.zh: 表5:输入配置和CPVB的偏差. 顺序表示时间顺序信息,Text表示可用的临床环境. 最好的结果用黑体表示。

blocks.en: Replacing attention-map subtraction with addition reduces all four metrics, including decreases of 0.0110 in CE F1, 0.0064 in F1RadGraph and 0.0071 in VLScore. This result supports attention-map subtraction as a design choice and is consistent with its intended role of reducing shared temporal responses and emphasising interval-change evidence. PriorRG-Style Fusion obtains a similar BLEU-4 score, but its CE F1, F1RadGraph and VLScore are lower by 0.0258, 0.0085 and 0.0114, respectively, showing that the benefit of CPVB/PGFA extends beyond lexical overlap. Retaining only one Cross-Attention unit substantially reduces BLEU-4, F1RadGraph and VLScore. Together, these results support the progression-difference branch, spatial guidance, attention-map subtraction and both Cross-Attention units. Additional experiments in the supplementary material examine decoder selection and the reduction factor r r . DistilGPT2 provides the best observed balance between generation performance and decoder size, while r = 2 r=2 gives the strongest overall CPVB result.
blocks.zh: 用加法取代注意力图减法,减少所有四个度量,包括CE F1, 0.0110, F1RadGraph 0.064和VLScore 0.071。 这一结果支持将注意力-映射减作为设计选择,符合其减少共享时间响应和强调间隔变化证据的预期作用. PreformerRG-Style Fusion获得相似的BLEU-4分数,但其CE F1,F1RadGraph和VLScore分别较低于0.0258,0.0085和0.0114,表明CPVB/PGFA的好处超越了词汇重叠. 仅保留一个交叉留守装置可大大减少BLEU-4、F1RadGraph和VLScore。 这些结果共同支持了进向偏差分支,空间引导,注意力-映射减值以及两个交叉偏差单位. 补充材料中的其他实验检查解码器的选择和还原系数rr。 DistilGPT2在生成性能和解码器大小之间提供了最佳的观测平衡,而r = 2 r= 2则给出了最强的整体CPVB结果.

blocks.en: 4.4 Clinical Case Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.4 临床案例分析

blocks.en: To examine performance on real clinical data, three collaborating radiologists evaluated 135 de-identified chest X-ray cases selected through stratified random sampling across 14 clinical observation categories. The sample was designed to cover diverse clinical findings rather than reflect their natural prevalence. One radiologist performed the initial assessment of each generated report, and two others reviewed it. This non-interventional secondary-data study was approved by the ethics committees of the authors’ institution and the source clinical institution. The research team had no access to direct patient identifiers or re-identification keys. Further details on reader experience, case selection, review procedure and assessment criteria are provided in the supplementary material. As shown in Tab. 6 , 89.6% of the reports in this stratified evaluation set were judged overall correct. This includes 60.7% that were completely correct and 28.9% that contained only minor omissions. A further 5.93% contained correct findings, incorrect statements and/or important omissions, while 4.44% were completely incorrect. These results are preliminary given the sample size, but they permit analysis of the model’s successes and remaining errors on clinical cases.
blocks.zh: 为了检查真实临床数据的性能,三名合作放射学家通过分级随机抽样,对从14个临床观测类别中挑选的135个脱识别胸部X射线病例进行了评估。 该样本旨在涵盖各种临床发现,而不是反映其自然流行率。 一名放射学家对每份报告进行了初步评估,另两名对报告进行了审查。 这一不干预的二级数据研究得到了提交人机构和来源临床机构的伦理委员会的批准。 研究小组无法获得直接的病人识别器或重新识别钥匙。 关于读者经验、案例选择、审查程序和评估标准的进一步详情见补充材料。 如图6所示,本分级评价中89.6%的报告总体上是正确的。 其中60.7%完全正确,28.9%只是略微遗漏。 另有5.93%的调查结论正确、陈述不正确和(或)重要遗漏,而4.44%完全不正确。 考虑到样本规模,这些结果是初步的,但可以分析模型的成功和临床病例的其余错误。

blocks.en: Table 6: Report-level evaluation of 135 chest X-ray cases. Overall correct is the sum of completely and partially correct reports. Partially correct denotes reports with correct information and minor omissions. Mixed & Missing denotes reports containing correct and incorrect statements and/or missing important findings. Completely incorrect denotes no correct information.
blocks.zh: 表6:135个胸部X光病例的报告级评价。 总体正确是完全和部分正确报告的总和。 部分正确是指有正确资料和略微遗漏的报告。 混合和缺失是指包含正确和不正确的陈述和/或缺失重要结论的报告。 完全不正确表示没有正确信息。

blocks.en: Fig. 5 shows three representative cases. The first agrees with the normal reference, reporting clear lungs, normal heart size and no pleural effusion or pneumothorax. The second identifies an implanted cardiac device and no pulmonary abnormality, but calls the device an AICD rather than a pacemaker and adds details absent from the reference. The third captures pulmonary oedema and opacities but describes basilar confluent opacities instead of the reported multiple bilateral inflammatory opacities. These cases reveal errors in device classification, disease distribution and diagnostic specificity.
blocks.zh: 图5显示了三个具有代表性的案件。 第一种说法与正常参考一致,报告肺清,心脏正常大小,没有胸膜充血或肺炎. 第二种识别出一个植入式心脏装置,没有肺异常,但称该装置为AICD而不是心脏起搏器,并添加了参考文献中缺失的细节. 第三种捕捉肺水肿和不透明,但描述了巴氏孔隙不透明,而不是所报告的多种双边炎症不透明。 这些病例揭示了设备分类,疾病分布和诊断特异性等方面的错误.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented CPVB-RG, a prior-aware framework designed to distinguish progression-related differences from shared spatial responses and connect this longitudinal evidence with clinical context through prior-guided image-text alignment and lightweight autoregressive decoding. Experiments on MIMIC-CXR [ 16 ] and IU X-Ray [ 9 ] show improvements across natural language generation and clinically grounded metrics. Controlled ablations support the design, while evaluation on 135 clinical cases reveals remaining errors in device classification, disease distribution and diagnostic specificity. Future work will examine irregular or missing priors and multi-institutional validation.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了CPVB-RG,这是一个预先意识到的框架,旨在区分与进度有关的差异与共享空间反应,并通过前导图像文本对齐和轻量级自递归解码将这一纵向证据与临床环境联系起来。 关于MIMIC-CXR [16] 和IU X-Ray [9] 的实验显示,自然语言生成和基于临床的衡量标准都有改进。 受控制的淤青有助于设计,而对135个临床病例的评价显示,在设备分类、疾病分布和诊断特性方面仍存在错误。 今后的工作将审查不规则或缺失的前科和多机构鉴定。
